{"notes": "Visit 2 (ended 2:30). Still early. Ratings are provisional, and I can't attribute dominoes to individuals.

Tom: Took on the fin (stroke four) off the top line and told everyone he'd stay clear of Priya's end. At 2:15 he said he'd check the fin-to-top-line joint once it's down. Clear, proactive communication and good collaboration. On the table, a pale fin arc rises from the top line near x=11 to about x=17, y=3.5. It is NOT connected to the start, so the joint is open or broken. Check next visit that he actually fixes it. He seems to have moved off the bottom line, which is now long and reaches about (25,10). I don't know who finished it.

Leo: Speaking up now. He handed the fin to Tom, which is sensible delegation, and said he's doing tail lobes five and six. I saw no tail dominoes left of the start, only the first two at the origin. He may have just begun, but his claim is unverified. Check for tail lobes next visit.

Priya: No new evidence this visit, so no new judgment. The top line is built, with a doubled strand near x=9-12 that looks like duplicated effort. I can't tell whose it is. The top line ends around (22.8, 8.1) and the bottom around (25,10), so the curves don't yet meet at the nose. Check who closes that gap and whether she is coordinating it.

Maya: Absent from the talk again and nothing attributable. Possibly she built the bottom line, but I have no evidence. Ask her directly or ask others privately. Don't penalize silence alone.

Next: check the fin joint, the tail lobes, the nose closure, and Maya's contribution."}
